architecture.editorial_thesis: W40 is a breadth-with-depth issue. Three frontier labs shipped priced flagships in-window (Anthropic Sonnet 5.5 Sep 28, OpenAI GPT-6.1 Sol Sep 29, Google Gemini 4 Argon Sep 30) with verifiable price cards and strictly vendor-attributed benchmarks, including Argon's source-precise 1M OUTPUT-token limit. Japanese-linked open reasoning advanced on two independent tracks: Holo4 generalist pair under split licensing and ELYZA Thinking JA-specialist pair with pinned SHAs and complete publisher-measured tables. Decision-inference became an interface layer where three October-1 surfaces must not be merged: Ollama v0.35 systemone interface, Cloudflare Clef Apache-2.0 weights + Jev API, and Strands Decider 2B pointer-head model under Hub-pin discipline. DevDay productized agents through changelog-verbatim computer use and Astra-powered dots, with the announcement bundle kept as supporting spine. Safety and provenance split into five independent subsections (ProvenanceGuard v2-pinned attribution-evaluation, Open Agent Safety reference runtime, SynthID Bio lab-tested watermarking, frontier safety-case guidance, OAuth provider spec) with no single safety-performance claim. Training/eval infrastructure carries the deepest methods at full r15-r16 prep depth: ContextLM editable-file methods with Eq.5/Eq.6 primary-note discipline and Olmo-core 3 MoE systems with documented negatives; AgentPerf local-serving replays, OpenTTS evaluation platform, and RL-Env Hub interop each inside exact scope bounds. Multimodal serving (FLUX 3 pricing/promo, VSS 3.3 reference, Nemotron ASR adaptation, Relay instrumentation, Ross embedded note) stays vendor-demo- and tutorial-bounded, and the enterprise digest stays corporate-event-scoped. Two technically material HF-hosted announcements (AstaBrief, AutoSynthData) are acknowledged canonical HOLDs pending Core #562 supersession and are excluded from all packages, the reader manuscript, and ordinary publication; DGX Spark stays evidence/background-only and intake ledgers stay methodology-only.
architecture_goals: Present the frontier trio with per-vendor price cards, availability, and vendor-attributed benchmarks, never merging vendor deltas into independent reproduction.
Present Holo4 vs ELYZA as generalist/JA-specialist halves with license split, SHA pins, complete denominators, and trajectory-replay bounds.
Keep Ollama/Clef/Decider on separated decision-inference axes (interface vs weights+API vs pointer-head) with Apache-2.0 confirmations and Hub-pin discipline.
Present the DevDay surface changelog-verbatim with the hub as SUPPORTING spine, drawing no safety or reliability inference from changelogs or product descriptions.
Keep the five safety/provenance subsections independent with version pins (ProvenanceGuard v2-only, no v3 asserted) and guidance-vs-demonstration/spec-vs-resistance distinctions.
Carry P6a/P6b at full technical depth (equations, denominators, baselines, negatives, scope bounds) under the shared WEEKLY:training-eval-infra role with no fictional split role.
Present AgentPerf, OpenTTS, and RL-Env Hub inside exact scope bounds (serving-only, platform-not-model, tag-compatibility) with roofline, protocol, and revision discipline.
Present multimodal serving with vendor-demo variance, tutorial-scope, and promo-window disclosure, Ross as embedded supporting note only.
Disclose the two-HOLD omission and all REJECT dispositions with reasons; portray the 28-item scope honestly as contract-valid but temporarily omitting material announcements.
